title: Food-delivery promo codes: a redemption limit enforced with read-then-write
name: Promo code limits

questions.prompt: Marketing launched PIZZA20 limited to the first 500 orders and pushed it to every app user at 18:00. Finance counted 4,212 orders with the discount. The dashboard's redemption counter for the code read 611, so the limit check never saw how many had really been used. Fix promos/redemptions.ts so the tests pass, keeping the counter in the shared store.
